summary: RETEST of iteration_36 env-var fix for image-to-video routing. All 5 tests pass. Chat I2V now persists an ABSOLUTE https:// kie_image_url (was relative /api/files/... in iter36), the new defensive guard in _kick_off_image_to_video correctly stamps media_status='failed' + clear error text when handed a relative URL (no wasted Kie task), the image-edit fast-path is unregressed, the social queue no longer emits the 'no public base URL' WARNING (env fallback chain resolves via FRONTEND_URL), and text-only video prompts still route to the legacy Veo path (_kick_off_video → veo3_fast).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:7902-7906 fallback chain PUBLIC_ORIGIN_OVERRIDE → FRONTEND_URL is now consistent with social_posts.py:2363-2368. Good. Consider extracting this into a shared `_public_base_url()` helper in a utils module — the chain is duplicated in at least two places and any future addition (e.g. PUBLIC_BASE_URL) risks drift.
server.py is still 11,733 lines — pre-existing issue flagged in iter36. Not blocking this fix but should be split into modules.

server.py:7936-7937 the outer try/except in the chat multi-file upload still catches ALL exceptions from the I2V fast-path and silently falls through to the image-edit path. With the new RuntimeError guard on missing base URL this becomes a footgun: if PUBLIC_ORIGIN_OVERRIDE/FRONTEND_URL are ever unset in prod, users will silently get the image-edit result again (the original user complaint). Consider surfacing at least a warning message to the user or wiring an admin-visible alarm.

social_posts.py:2373-2381 correctly logs a WARNING when image_public_url can't be resolved, but the request still proceeds with image_public_url=None (falls back to text-to-video). Consider surfacing this fallback in the post's `video_error` field so users can see 'video generated without image anchoring' instead of silently losing the source frame.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_I2V37* team + direct conversation created under reggie's org, 3 agent messages (1 pending I2V, 1 failed I2V from guard test, 1 image-edit reply), 1 pending Veo video message, 1 TEST_iter37 social_post inserted directly via Mongo with local /api/files/social/{uuid}.png image + a 'pending' video job. Not cleaned up — background Kie polls may still complete/fail asynchronously.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_36 bug is FIXED. Concrete proof captured in test output: kie_image_url=https://emergent-wing.preview.emergentagent.com/api/files/conv/<cid>/<uuid>.png for the chat I2V path. The defensive guard at server.py:7162 fires correctly on relative URLs. The social queue no longer emits the 'no public base URL is configured' warning. For production (foundryagents.ai), ensure PUBLIC_ORIGIN_OVERRIDE=https://foundryagents.ai (or matching FRONTEND_URL) is set in the prod backend .env — the code will fail-fast otherwise thanks to the new guard, which is preferable to the silent failure of iter36.
rca of the issue: ITER36 RCA: chat + social I2V paths read PUBLIC_BASE_URL/REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, but backend .env only has PUBLIC_ORIGIN_OVERRIDE (empty in preview) and FRONTEND_URL (set). Result: source_url handed to Kie's Kling I2V was relative → Kie's server-side image fetch 4xx'd → mp4 never materialised → users saw 'video is being generated' spinner forever, or the outer try/except swallowed the failure and fell through to image-edit (this was the original 'video request returned an image' user complaint). FIX (ITER37 verified): (a) server.py:7902-7906 reads PUBLIC_ORIGIN_OVERRIDE → FRONTEND_URL fallback; (b) social_posts.py:2363-2368 same fallback + WARNING log if unresolvable; (c) server.py:7162 defensive guard in _kick_off_image_to_video returns failed message rather than submitting a doomed Kie job when image_url is relative. Confirmed by test: kie_image_url on the persisted pending message now starts with https://.
